articles.title: Trump lands in Senate's crosshairs over $500 million UAE investment in his crypto venture
articles.snippet: Senate Democrats call for hearings into whether a $500 million investment by UAE officials in World Liberty Financial influenced Trump's policy decisions.

articles.title: Senate Dems urge probe into $500M crypto deal between Trumps, UAE
articles.snippet: Democrats want the Senate to hold hearings on the dealings between the Trump administration, World Liberty Financial and Abu Dhabi royalty.

articles.title: Crypto isn't problem with US economy, Louisiana senator says
articles.snippet: Louisiana Senator John Kennedy largely dismissed what he called the “promotion” of cryptocurrency by the Digital Chamber CEO Cody Carbone in a Senate hearing on affordability.

articles.title: OpenAI Turns Up the Heat With Jalapeño, Its First Custom AI Chip
articles.snippet: Built with Broadcom, the LLM-focused accelerator is the first step in OpenAI's effort to design the hardware behind ChatGPT and beyond.

articles.title: Crypto’s Clarity Act Has a New Enemy: Catholic Leaders
articles.snippet: A group of 82 Catholic leaders warned a key provision of the crypto bill, protecting software developers from prosecution, could enable human trafficking.
